title: Fake videos offered to James Fox

tellings.quote: People have already tried to sell so many videos to him. But they're not real.

plain: People in Brazil are said to have tried many times to sell videos to the filmmaker James Fox, and the videos are said to be fake. A surgeon named Italo Venturelli, who says his hospital operated on an alien, tells Michels this, saying, "people have already tried to sell so many videos to him. But they're not real." His point is that fakes have grown up around the story, separate from what he says he witnessed.
